cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(openusd_web_probe LANGUAGES CXX)

if(NOT EMSCRIPTEN)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Use emcmake cmake -S thirdparty/openusd/web_probe -B thirdparty/openusd/probe-build -DOPENUSD_SDK=/path/to/emscripten-sdk. Desktop SDKs cannot be used. Web support remains unverified.")
endif()
set(OPENUSD_SDK "" CACHE PATH "OpenUSD v24.08 installed Emscripten SDK, including TBB and plugin resources")
if(NOT EXISTS "${OPENUSD_SDK}/pxrConfig.cmake")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "OPENUSD_SDK must contain pxrConfig.cmake from an Emscripten OpenUSD install; build.py only builds desktop SDKs")
endif()
find_package(pxr CONFIG REQUIRED PATHS "${OPENUSD_SDK}" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
add_executable(openusd_web_probe main.cpp)
target_compile_features(openusd_web_probe PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(openusd_web_probe SYSTEM PRIVATE "${OPENUSD_SDK}/include")
if(TARGET usd_ms)
    target_link_libraries(openusd_web_probe PRIVATE usd_ms)
elseif(TARGET usdGeom)
    target_link_libraries(openusd_web_probe PRIVATE usdGeom usd sdf plug tf vt gf)
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "SDK must export usd_ms or the native OpenUSD split CMake targets")
endif()
target_compile_options(openusd_web_probe PRIVATE -pthread -fexceptions)
target_link_options(openusd_web_probe PRIVATE
    -pthread -fexceptions -sDISABLE_EXCEPTION_CATCHING=0 -sALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1
    -sPTHREAD_POOL_SIZE=4 -sEXIT_RUNTIME=1
    "SHELL:--preload-file \"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mesh.usda@/mesh.usda\"")
# Schema metadata is needed even when all native code is linked statically.
if(NOT EXISTS "${OPENUSD_SDK}/lib/usd/plugInfo.json")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "SDK is missing lib/usd/plugInfo.json and schema/plugin resources")
endif()
target_link_options(openusd_web_probe PRIVATE
    "SHELL:--preload-file \"${OPENUSD_SDK}/lib/usd@/usd/lib/usd\"")
set_target_properties(openusd_web_probe PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".js")
find_program(NODE_EXECUTABLE node)
if(NODE_EXECUTABLE)
    enable_testing()
    add_test(NAME openusd_web_smoke COMMAND "${NODE_EXECUTABLE}" "$<TARGET_FILE:openusd_web_probe>")
    set_tests_properties(openusd_web_smoke PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)
endif()
